"I hope, wherever she is, that Cheryl is smiling and being able to finally see where our journey has ended. Though she is not here physically to see it, she will forever live on in spirit and in my heart to watch our favourite series finally close its chapter."

"Cheryl was my inspiration and my motivation to keep living. To keep striving and to continue to help spread her legacy as not only a writer, but a friend. With aot coming to an end, I find myself feeling an enormous amount of bittersweet nostalgia."

"Though as summer came to an end, and so did AOT season 1, I learned what grief truly was and dedicated myself to remembering Cherry-chan through pieces of my writing and many symbols from the SNK series itself."

"Not only did i lose a friend, i lost a part of me. For days on end i was unable to process the fact my one online friend at the time had let go; and i hadnt even gotten to say goodbye. Merely a week ago we were talking about attack on titan and its future."

"I could only feel my heart tear in half as i read the words on my computer screen; wanting to believe i was simply having a nightmare and any moment id wake up and find her safe and sound in our dms  Cheryl had unfortunately passed away merely a day after her letter was posted"

"I was 13 at the time, unable to process my emotions properly and had been met face to face with a goodbye letter from the one girl who i considered a sister. Cheryl had finally spilled everything in that letter; and i found out she had hidden her diagnosis of Leukaemia."

"towards the end of the summer of 2014, I discovered a long letter dedicated to not only me, but several other of Cheryls mutuals on her page. Her attack on titan stories had been unlisted and i felt my heart drop to my stomach as i opened the url."

"Though, right before the ending, Cheryl and I had a falling out due to personal reasons and both of us stopped talking for a bit. For a week i went no contact and felt guilt begin to rise; and finally decided to confront her and went to her personal page."

"Cheryl and I went through a lot together. Her health continued to to decline and throughout it all, we talked and gushed about attack on titan and what the finale would bring. As far as i saw, she was acting like same old cherry"

"She messaged me on and off most days, and when i asked her if she was alright she told me with utmost confidence she "would be just fine and i dont need to worry for her". I couldnt bring myself to push her, so i believed her and left it at that."

"My best friend was suffering with constant nose bleeds, sensitivity regards to her senses/bright lights, and was too weak to even attend school. She was also reported by her mutual that she was losing hair fast- though Cheryl, always kind, said for us not to worry"

"Before the finale of season 1 of Attack On Titan, Cheryl became more and more distant from our friend group and wasnt responding to messages. I became overly concerned and reached out to one of her irl mutuals to see what was going on; Cheryl was unfortunately unbelievably sick"

"Cheryls alias was known as Cherry, and her and i together were unstoppable. Cheryl was and still is one of my greatest blessings, and i thank the universe everyday we crossed paths. Though with life comes with unfair consequences."

"Cheryl was a brilliant young writer whom i looked up to greatly. I met her at 12 years old over a fanfiction website and we both shared a love for attack on titan and eren jaeger as a whole. We became instant best friends through this series and i treasured her."
